entities.description: An elderly man with white hair and heavily wrinkled, sun-spotted skin is shown in profile, leaning his forehead against a young child's head in a tender gesture. He is wearing a white polo shirt with a dark blue trim on the collar and sleeves, and has a gentle, smiling expression.

clothing.trim: dark navy blue on collar and cuffs
